title: FilterGraph
description: An FFmpeg filtergraph consisting of one or more filter chains.

chains.description: The filter chains that make up the filtergraph. Chains are separated by ';' in the FFmpeg filtergraph string.

sws_flags.description: Global scaling flags passed to libswscale (e.g. 'lanczos', 'bicubic'). Prepended as 'sws_flags=<value>;' in the filtergraph string.

FilterChain.description: A linear sequence of filters. Adjacent filters are connected implicitly; filters are separated by ',' in the FFmpeg filtergraph string.

Filter.description: A single FFmpeg filter with optional input/output stream labels and arguments.

input_labels.description: Stream labels consumed by this filter (e.g. '[main]', '[0:v]'). Rendered as '[label]' before the filter name.

instance.description: Optional instance identifier appended as '@<instance>' to distinguish multiple uses of the same filter.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the filter. Either an object for key=value pairs (KVArgs) or an array for positional arguments (PositionalArgs).

output_labels.description: Stream labels produced by this filter. Rendered as '[label]' after the filter and its arguments.

KVArgs.description: Key-value filter arguments. Each entry is serialized as 'key=value' and joined with ':'. An empty string value renders the key as a flag (no '=value').

PositionalArgs.description: Positional filter arguments joined with ':'. Used by filters like 'format' that accept values without keys.

Label.description: A stream label used to connect filters across chains. May also be an FFmpeg input stream specifier such as '0:v' or '1:a'.
